- len(crate) must return the item count.

import unittest

import solution


class ExplodingIterable:
    def __iter__(self):
        raise RuntimeError("iteration failed")


class ParcelCrateTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_constructor_copy_owner_length_and_empty(self):
        source = [{"parts": [1]}, []]
        crate = solution.ParcelCrate("forge", source)
        self.assertEqual(crate.owner, "forge")
        self.assertEqual(len(crate), 2)
        self.assertFalse(crate.empty())
        source[0]["parts"].append(2)
        source.append("later")
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [{"parts": [1]}, []])
        with self.assertRaises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
            crate.owner = "other"
        self.assertTrue(solution.ParcelCrate("owner").empty())

    def test_add_and_contents_are_deeply_isolated(self):
        crate = solution.ParcelCrate("owner")
        item = {"nested": [[1]]}
        self.assertIsNone(crate.add(item))
        item["nested"][0].append(2)
        first = crate.contents()
        self.assertEqual(first, [{"nested": [[1]]}])
        first[0]["nested"][0].append(9)
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [{"nested": [[1]]}])
        self.assertIsNot(first, crate.contents())

    def test_discard_first_equal_and_return_copy(self):
        crate = solution.ParcelCrate("owner", [[1], [2], [1]])
        removed = crate.discard([1])
        self.assertEqual(removed, [1])
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [[2], [1]])
        removed.append(99)
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [[2], [1]])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            crate.discard([3])
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [[2], [1]])

    def test_repeated_references_do_not_leak_aliases(self):
        shared = {"x": []}
        crate = solution.ParcelCrate("owner", [shared, shared])
        view = crate.contents()
        view[0]["x"].append(1)
        self.assertEqual(crate.contents(), [{"x": []}, {"x": []}])

    def test_validation_and_iteration_exceptions(self):
        for owner, items in (("", []), (None, []), (1, []), ("ok", "abc"),
                             ("ok", 123)):
            with self.subTest(owner=owner, items=items):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    solution.ParcelCrate(owner, items)
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            solution.ParcelCrate("ok", ExplodingIterable())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
